subject: Tick: sample provenance once at tick start; coverage regen after sim-results
body: Two recurring issues seen landing tick 20260921T163915Z (#960). (1) Running two evidence-mint requests in one tick leaves the SECOND result provenance.workingTreeClean=false: run-requests.mjs samples provenance per-request, and the first request's mac-run.json write dirties the tree before the second samples. Sample provenance ONCE at tick start (before any request) so all results in a tick share the clean launch state. (2) A tick that writes sim-results does not regenerate docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md, so every tick-results PR fails check-surface-review-coverage until the cloud regenerates on landing (done for #960). Both are CI-verifiable script changes. The customer-path re-mint came back sound (provenance 59f04e4b) — thank you; it superseded the stale #952.
